title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-124-25二模

items.zh: 我们没有泡面了,你下楼的时候去买几包好吗?
items.en: We are out of instant noodles. Could you grab a few packs when you go downstairs?

items.zh: 为了避免意外受伤,他锻炼的时候始终保持适当的强度。
items.en: To avoid accidental injuries, he consistently exercises at a moderate intensity.

items.zh: 蛇年到来,愿你如灵蛇般冷静果敢,敏锐地抓住生活中的每一个宝贵机遇。
items.en: As the Year of the Snake arrives, may you be as calm and decisive as a wise snake, keenly seizing every precious opportunity in life.

items.zh: 如果你感到孤独、迷茫,请务必翻开这本书,它会给你勇气,助你挣脱生活的樊笼,寻到内心的光芒与自由。
items.en: If you feel lonely and lost, be sure to open this book, which will give you courage to break free from the chains/shackles of daily life and find your inner light and freedom.
